items.html: The general rule that emerges is that there is Atik and AA of MA, and Atik and AA of BON, and correspondingly, exactly, Abba and Yeshsut of MA, Bina and Tvuna of BON, and correspondingly, exactly, ZA and Yaakov of MA, Rachel and Leah of BON. Thus there are three aspects: for AA of the male is to Atik of the male just as Yeshsut is to Abba, and just as Yaakov is to ZA. Likewise, the Nukva of AA is to the Nukva of Atik just as Tvuna is to Bina, and just as the small Rachel is to the upper Rachel. It follows that when all the aspects are combined, there are three aspects of male and female, namely: one, Atik and Nukva, in which AA and Nukva are included; two, Abba and Ima, in which Yeshsut are included; three, ZON, in which Yaakov and Rachel are included.
